chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me of: from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub. And al-Husayn ibn Ubayd Allah informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two, peace be upon them, who said:

I said to him: A man entered into the salat (prayer) while he had performed tayammum, then he prayed one rak'ah, then he broke his state of purity, and then found water. He said: "He goes out and performs wudu (ablution), then resumes building upon what has already passed of his salat (prayer) which he prayed with tayammum."

key_terms.أَحْدَثَ: he invalidated his state of ritual purity
key_terms.بِالتَّيَمُّمِ: with tayammum as the initial form of purification
key_terms.مُتَيَمِّمٌ: one who has performed tayammum as a substitute purification
key_terms.يَبْنِي: he continues and completes on the basis of what he already performed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone starts salat (prayer) with tayammum and then finds water after breaking purity?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who began salat (prayer) with tayammum and then, after invalidating his state of purity, found water. The Imam عليهما السلام states that he should leave, perform wudu (ablution), and then continue from the portion of the prayer already completed.
